thesis: Stable observed bank buffers support retaining an income thesis, but a single quarterly recovery does not establish sustained earnings acceleration or an attractive current price. The bear establishes reasons to wait, not evidence of structural impairment. Neutral is more defensible than a directional buy or sell.
strongest_counterexample: Q2 profit and net interest margin improved, while reported CET1 of 14.92%, liquidity ratios and the interim dividend provide tangible resilience and income evidence.
invalidation_conditions: Two subsequent comparable quarters with attributable-profit growth above 0% and a dated valuation assessment would invalidate the present lack-of-confirmed-recovery basis and require a fresh buy assessment.
A subsequent comparable report with CET1 below the observed 14.92% and attributable-profit growth below 0% would weaken the stable-buffer-and-earnings foundation and require adverse reassessment.
evidence_gaps: Current bank valuation on a validated share basis.
Post-June30 asset-quality, funding-margin and capital data.
decisive_factors: Q2 profit grew 2.4% while half-year profit was slightly below the prior year.
Reported capital and liquidity buffers are June30 observations.
Industrial FCF treatment is inappropriate for a bank.
